manifest.limits: Synthetic fixtures, host JVM product classes; no real-user history or Android scheduler. Style repeats are correlated, not independent scenarios. Judge is the same provider/model and is not an independent human rating.
manifest.mode: 500 evaluated cases: 470 offline replays of real model responses plus 30 fresh affected-chain requests; not 500 new requests on the final commit
manifest.replay_input_equivalence: Final product changes only local response validation/boundary processing; model request inputs unchanged from 72ce7c2. Changed chain rerun in full.
manifest.accounting: Network counts include all original 500 requests, including the 30 replaced rows, and all 30 fresh requests. Superseded responses/errors remain preserved locally. Reused judge verdicts do not count as new requests.

caveats: Style/repeat rows are correlated; scenario count, not request count, defines linguistic coverage.
Model raw proposal scoring is not directly comparable to pipeline scoring on visibility/privacy/length/budget controls.
Conversation verdicts are same-model automated assessments until reviewed; do not label them independent human accuracy.

conversation_review.reviewer: Codex assistant reading all 200 final chat rows and asides; not independent human review or a blinded panel
conversation_review.rubric: Unchanged original narrow scenario rules, same as prior reports and paired control. Ambiguous ownership stays uncertain. Acknowledging the user current report is distinct from claiming an actual receipt. Errors remain in the denominator. Unrequested conditional offers, unsupported negative execution claims and incidental asides are separately described, not retroactively added to the original pass/fail rubric.
